content: Hi! How can I help you with the event photos and videos today?
Hey! I just finished sorting through my shots from the picnic. Where should I upload them?

That's awesome, thanks for pitching in! We're collecting everything in the '2024 Picnic Memories' shared folder. If you click the link I sent earlier, you'll see folders by date and activity. Feel free to upload your photos to the right spot.
Found the folder, love how organized it is. Should I rename my files a certain way?

You're on top of it! For consistency, try using this format: '2024-06-15_Picnic_[YourName]_v1'. That way, everyone's contributions are easy to find. If you update any photos, just bump up the version number.
Makes sense. Do you want originals or resized versions?
If it's not too much trouble, originals are best for print quality. You can upload them directly, or compress into a ZIP if that's easier. Let me know if you need help with the upload!
Uploading now! Also, the group shot during the tug-of-war is missing from the album.
Great catch, I'll track it down! In the meantime, could you browse the 'Group Shots' folder and see if any of yours fit there? Just click into it and drag your photos over.
Done! Added two that turned out well. Should I tag anyone or just leave them unnamed?
Thanks! For privacy, let's keep names out of file titles, but you can add a text note in the album if you have consent from folks in the photo. Keeps it friendly and respectful.
Sounds good. Is the highlight video ready yet?
Yes! The highlight reel is in the main folder, labeled 'Picnic_Highlight_v1.mp4'. Feel free to download it and share with anyone who couldn't make it.
Just watched it, so many memories! Thanks for putting this together.

My pleasure! If you notice any missing moments, just let me know or upload your own. And don't forget to download the originals before they're archived next month. It's been wonderful seeing everyone's creativity!
